correctness.rationale: I reconstructed the Laplacian resolvent/centering identity and checked N/B derivative numerator W=N'B-NB' using the record's complete integer polynomial adjugate verifier. Independent SymPy enumeration over every connected unlabeled graph of orders 2,3,4 and all binary nonconstant sources found only the complementary P4 end-block source configurations with negative derivative at large t. The actual full labeled enumeration code traverses every 2^(n choose 2) graph edge mask and all 2^n-2 source masks, verifying nonnegative W coefficients for the other 534 and 24 labelled exceptions, and rational closed form for the exceptional case; n=2:2, n=3:24, n=4:532 source/graph cases. Nonnegative coefficients prove ALL t>=0, not sampled t. At formally infinite t the index is undefined because field constant; only one-sided limit is asserted.
